_readme: One entry per real product subcategory (from the company profile PDF). To add a new subcategory: add an object here with a unique 'slug', set 'gender' to 'mens' or 'womens', add matching item entries in catalog_items.json with the same 'category' slug, add images under /assets/images/products/<slug>/, then re-run scripts/build_site.py.
